Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Landscape Print with Copper Leaf Wall Art Decor on Canvas - 35" x 35"
Materials: canvas
Bring a sense of classic elegance into your home with this enchanting piece of landscape wall art. Reminiscent of traditional landscape art, this print utilizes a serene color palette that will complement most home-décor styles. This piece is printed on canvas and features hand-painted details. 35"H x 35"W x 1.5"D Printed canvas with hand-painted details This abstract landscape features white clouds with shades of blue and gold accents. Hanging materials not included Frame not included
